cases.purpose: Assert literal ordered operands and Linux priority/discard bits with every swapon syscall answered by seccomp notification, without enabling swap.
cases.oracle: Explicit Linux ABI values and literal operand contract; not util-linux path normalization.
cases.comparison: Exact ordered syscall records, success responses, empty output, and unchanged /proc/swaps.
cases.script:
set -u
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/system-seccomp.py
D=/tmp/parity-case
[[ $(type -t swapon) == builtin ]] || exit 125
/usr/bin/cat /proc/swaps > "$D/swapon-before" || exit 125
: > "$D/swapon-log"
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 /usr/bin/python3 "$H" --notify swapon --reply swapon=0 --log-string swapon=0 --log-args swapon=1 --log "$D/swapon-log" -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c '
  [[ $(type -t swapon) == builtin ]] || exit 125
  swapon /fixture/plain &&
  swapon -p 0 /fixture/p0 &&
  swapon -p 1 /fixture/p1 &&
  swapon -p 32767 /fixture/pmax &&
  swapon -d /fixture/discard &&
  swapon -d -p 5 /fixture/both &&
  swapon -- -name s1
' > "$D/swapon-out" 2> "$D/swapon-err" || exit $?
[[ ! -s "$D/swapon-out" && ! -s "$D/swapon-err" ]] || exit 1
/usr/bin/cmp -s "$D/swapon-before" /proc/swaps || exit 1
/usr/bin/python3 - "$D/swapon-log" <<'PY_CHECK'
import json, sys
expected = [('/fixture/plain', 0), ('/fixture/p0', 0x8000),
            ('/fixture/p1', 0x8001), ('/fixture/pmax', 0xffff),
            ('/fixture/discard', 0x10000), ('/fixture/both', 0x18005),
            ('-name', 0), ('s1', 0)]
with open(sys.argv[1]) as f:
    records = [json.loads(line) for line in f]
actual = [(r.get('string0'), r.get('arg1')) for r in records]
if actual != expected or any(r.get('syscall') != 'swapon' or r.get('reply') != 'value:0' for r in records):
    print('unexpected supervisor records:', records, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
PY_CHECK
